invariants.description: Throttle multiplier is deterministic; identical inputs always produce identical output
Every compute() writes THROTTLE_EVENT to HMAC-chained ledger before returning
Multiplier never falls below AMT_FLOOR (0.05) without HUMAN-0 emergency override
Override and weight reconfiguration require non-empty HUMAN-0 operator identity
AMT ingests only THROTTLE_EVENT and PRESSURE_SNAPSHOT ledger record types
